title: Careers at stake: Supreme Court frowns upon YouTuber's reckless allegations against judges
description: The Supreme Court on Monday flagged concerns over how reckless allegations of corruption could ruin the careers of judicial officers.A Bench of Justices Dipankar Datta and Sheel Nagu made the observation while considering a plea by YouTuber Gulshan Pahuja.Pahuja had recently been sentenced to six months in jail by the Delhi High Court for criminal contempt of court for making scandalous remarks against the judiciary in his YouTube videos.Pahuja today told the Court that his only aim is to fight
